title: Underived proper exchange after base change to a geometric point
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of a scheme $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ be a geometric point with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point]. For any cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with horizontal maps $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ and $s$ and vertical maps $f\prime:X\prime\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ and $f$, the specified underived exchange component [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange] $s^{-1}f_*F\to f\prime_*g\prime^{-1}F$ is an isomorphism. There is no torsion hypothesis on $F$ or $\Lambda$.

source.place: Tag 0A3T (lemma-proper-pushforward-stalk), with the canonical exchange compatibility from Tag 0A3U (lemma-proper-base-change-f-star)

proof.text: Apply qcqs_geometricExchange_factorization. Properness supplies the qcqs instances; obtain the strictly local ring, its geometric closed point, a cartesian fibre square, the direct-image stalk/strict-local section isomorphism and the exact equality for the exchange stalk.

The structural base change of f is proper. Apply isIso_globalSectionsUpperStarMap_of_strictLocal_geometricClosedPoint to the cartesian fibre square and pulled-back sheaf. The middle restriction in the factorization is invertible.

The source inverse-image stalk comparison, e, the inverse-image composition comparison, the pushforward global-section comparison and the identity global germ are invertible. Rewrite by the factorization equality; their composite makes the identity geometric stalk of exchange invertible.

Use the conservative family consisting of the identity point on Spec Ω, indexed by PUnit. Its range covers Spec Ω. Lift its point to the coefficient universe, and transport invertibility by uliftSheafFiberIso. Joint reflection of isomorphisms proves the unchanged exchange component invertible.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0A3T and 0A3U; qcqs strict-local factorization, henselian-pair restriction and arbitrary separably closed field extension. Identity-stalk conservativity is proved with the singleton geometric family.
